rules.rule: Each beat must read as one visual shot idea. Split a second primary visual idea into another beat.
Default to one primary focal subject and at most one co-primary/support subject.
An opaque full-frame locationHandle owns the frame. Never use it as a partial rectangular insert or local effect.
Prefer Gold Set handles. Contextual handles require explicit Atlas inspection and visual justification.
EXCLUDE_DEFAULT handles are not normal creative choices.
Keep one coherent world-style family across a sequence; curated portrait dialogue is allowed only in dedicated dialogue/monitor compositions.
Major portrait dialogue and major world action should normally be adjacent beats rather than simultaneous primaries.
Use framing-based world-human scale guidance: extreme-wide 0.08-0.18, wide 0.12-0.28, medium 0.28-0.48, close 0.45-0.72.
Preserve established travel direction across adjacent action beats unless reversal is intentional; keep negative space ahead of travel.
Camera movement must improve storytelling/readability; do not add motion merely to make the shot feel cinematic.
Local impact/shield/explosion effects stay local; a full-frame location plate must never substitute for a local effect.
Do not invent scale hacks, duplicate locations, hidden backend fields, fake dialogue WorldActors or illegal projectile substitutions to work around engine behavior.
